title: you your never i my
rule: You/your; never I/my; we = Government of Canada. Second person in titles, links, nav (“Replace your card”). Don’t switch to speaking as the user. “My” only in proper names (My Service Canada Account). Name a specific institution only when that institution will contact / be contacted, or its role matters to the task.
pass_when: Titles/links/nav use you/your; we is GC; “My” only in proper names; institutions named only when they matter to the task.
fail_when: I/my in UI chrome; speaking as the user; a specific institution named with no task reason.
overview: Address the public as you; we means Government of Canada, never I/my in chrome.
apply_when: Writing Canada.ca titles, links, nav, and instructional voice.
not_when: Proper names that legally include My, such as My Service Canada Account.
agent_hint: Use you/your in chrome; we is GC; name institutions only when the task needs them.
description: Canada.ca speaks in second person (you/your) in titles, links, and nav (“Replace your card”). We means the Government of Canada. Never switch to speaking as the user with I/my in UI chrome; “My” appears only in proper names (My Service Canada Account). Name a specific institution only when that institution will contact or be contacted, or its role matters to the task. Fail I/my in chrome, speaking as the user, or naming an institution with no task reason.
